layers.scope: Breakdown partitions full Markdown BPE tokens by the first byte's line: model_body is published unit explain, summary, extras and uncertainties; signature_location includes shared source-file reference definitions (including ones used by relations); heading_anchor, relations, footer, INDEX and node_text (including labels/whitespace) partition the rest. model_body/source and published_markdown/source use complete frozen files. semantic: all published Markdown (node pages + INDEX, including navigation, signatures and commands); deterministic: catalog.json as serialized, including preserved prose copies and edge references, excluding the graph field; frozen graph is excluded from token ratios (frozen_graph_tokens=0), reported separately as frozen_graph_bytes using UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False and compact separators; complete graph evidence is expanded only with query --edges; source: complete frozen files counted once; context source chunks, host prompts, raw answers and summary.json excluded; layers are storage measures, not disjoint content classes

issues: gson/src/main/java/module-info.java::module_residual::::0: says the module works without the optional dependencies, but the source only declares requires static and does not establish that runtime code paths avoid them.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/Gson.java::method::Gson.newJsonWriter::35898: says the non-executable prefix is the four-byte string )}' plus newline, but the code writes the five-character prefix )]}' plus newline.

grp:GsonBuilder.java-registertypeadapter-and-override-guard: says hasNonOverridableAdapter rejects Object.class with IllegalArgumentException, but that helper only returns a boolean and registerTypeAdapter throws the exception.
grp:GsonBuilder.java-simple-flag-setters: omits the member excludeFieldsWithoutExposeAnnotation's excluder delegation and instead describes non-member setFieldNamingStrategy.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java::method::GsonBuilder.registerTypeHierarchyAdapter::36721: says exact-type registrations take precedence over hierarchy ones, but a hierarchy TypeAdapter is added to the same factories list and reverse registration order can let it precede an earlier exact-type adapter.

grp:JsonArray.java-jsonarray-add-methods: says a null argument array would propagate a NullPointerException from ArrayList.addAll, but the code dereferences array.elements first, so the NPE occurs before ArrayList.addAll is called.

grp:JsonObject.java-jsonobject-read-accessors: calls entrySet and keySet read-only views, but they are live backed views from the underlying map and can mutate the JsonObject through removal or entry updates.

grp:FieldNamingPolicy.java-fieldnamingpolicy-enum-constants: says aURL becomes a_u_r_l under the separator policies, but only LOWER_CASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES yields a_u_r_l; UPPER_CASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES yields A_U_R_L and the dash/dot policies use '-' and '.'.

grp:JsonPrimitive.java-hashcode-and-double-hashing: says hashOfDoubleValue uses Long.hashCode whenever the double is mathematically integral, but the code only does so when doubleValue == (long) doubleValue, so integral doubles outside long range use Double.hashCode.

grp:JsonSerializationContext.java-jsonserializationcontext: says serialize(Object) uses the object's runtime shape, but the source only says it invokes default serialization and does not specify runtime-type selection.

grp:ConstructorConstructor.java-constructor-lookup-entrypoints: says the filter is consulted even when an InstanceCreator exists only indirectly, but the code returns an InstanceCreatorConstructor before computing filterResult, so instance creators bypass the filter.

grp:ConstructorConstructor.java-constructor-lookup-entrypoints: says an interface or abstract raw type returns a ThrowingObjectConstructor, but Collection/Map interfaces and abstract collection/map types can be handled by newDefaultImplementationConstructor before checkInstantiable.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/LinkedTreeMap.java::method::LinkedTreeMap.find::4374: says a created node is linked before the header's prev, but the source links it after header.prev as the new header.prev at the end of iteration order.

grp:Streams.java-appendablewriter-and-currentwrite: says the char[]-based write lets the Appendable see a subSequence view without copying, but CurrentWrite.subSequence returns a new String, so that path copies.
grp:TypeAdapters.java-long-as-string-adapter: says reading is like LONG, but LONG_AS_STRING.read does not catch NumberFormatException and wrap it in JsonSyntaxException as LONG does.

grp:JavaTimeTypeAdapters.java-integer-fields-java-time-adapters: asserts JSON object field names/order and malformed-input exception surface from IntegerFieldsTypeAdapter, but that adapter's read/write loop is not in the supplied source.
grp:JavaTimeTypeAdapters.java-localdatetime-adapter: says a missing member triggers JsonSyntaxException, but a present null value also leaves the field null and triggers requireNonNullField.

grp:JavaTimeTypeAdapters.java-offsetdatetime-and-offsettime-adapters: says a missing member triggers JsonSyntaxException, but a present null value also leaves the field null and triggers requireNonNullField.
grp:JavaTimeTypeAdapters.java-zoneddatetime-adapter: says a missing member triggers JsonSyntaxException, but a present null value also leaves the field null and triggers requireNonNullField.

grp:ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.java-recordadapter: says readField throws IllegalStateException for a missing component, but Adapter.read catches IllegalStateException and wraps it as JsonSyntaxException, so the public failure surface is JsonSyntaxException.

grp:ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.java-createboundfield-and-its-boundfield-implementation: implies static final fields throw JsonIOException, but that branch only runs when blockInaccessible is false; when blocked, the accessibility check runs and field.set may throw IllegalAccessException.
grp:JsonTreeReader.java-nextdouble-and-nextlong: says both nextDouble and nextLong ASCII-validate STRING inputs first, but nextDouble does not call validateAscii; only nextLong does.

grp:NumberTypeAdapter.java-numbertypeadapter-class-and-factories: describes getFactory behavior even though getFactory is not a member of this group; getFactory is listed in grp:NumberTypeAdapter.java-numbertypeadapter-read-write, whose explanation omits it.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/JsonElementTypeAdapter.java::method::JsonElementTypeAdapter.read::2548: says malformed structure surfaces as reader IOExceptions and the IllegalStateException path comes only from readTerminal, but the source does not establish that exclusive failure surface for the reader calls.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/ObjectTypeAdapter.java::method::ObjectTypeAdapter.read::3491: says the only thrown exception is readTerminal's IllegalStateException, but the source does not establish that exclusive failure surface for the reader calls.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/ArrayTypeAdapter.java::method::ArrayTypeAdapter.read::2391: says unboxing nulls would throw, but the code passes list elements to Array.set without unboxing, so the failure surface is Array.set's exception rather than an unboxing NPE.

grp:ReflectionHelper.java-reflectionhelper-class: says record queries never fail merely because the JVM lacks records, but on a non-record JVM isRecord returns false while getRecordComponentNames, getAccessor, and getCanonicalRecordConstructor throw UnsupportedOperationException.

grp:ReflectionHelper.java-class-modifier-queries: says isAnonymousOrNonStaticLocal identifies inner classes that cannot be instantiated via a no-arg constructor, but the code only checks non-static plus anonymous/local and does not test constructors.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/util/ISO8601Utils.java::method::ISO8601Utils.parse::5200: describes accepted date/time and timezone formats as yyyy-MM-dd/yyyyMMdd and [+-]hh[:mm], but the code also accepts mixed dash/colon variants and +hhmm offsets.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReader.java::method::JsonReader.nextNonWhitespace::53619: says only comments require lenient mode and that '/' is otherwise returned as data, but checkLenient() is invoked for every '/' with following input before the comment/data distinction, so in non-lenient mode any '/' (even one that is not starting a comment) throws MalformedJsonException, and '/' is only ever returned as data in lenient mode or at end of input

grp:JsonWriter.java-formatting-configuration: says formattedColon is ': ' or ':' on the same condition as formattedComma (space-after-separators and empty newline), but the code sets formattedColon to ': ' whenever usesSpaceAfterSeparators() is true, regardless of newline.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java::method::JsonWriter.value::20995: says a malformed Number is rejected before any output is written, but writeDeferredName() runs before validation, so a pending property name is written before the IllegalArgumentException.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonWriter.java::method::JsonWriter.string::24404: says it selects the HTML-safe replacement table but does not state that this additionally escapes <, >, &, = and ', so the htmlSafe branch's output is not fully described.

grp:LazilyParsedNumber.java-lazilyparsednumber-numeric-conversions: says intValue/longValue fall back to BigDecimal and truncate rather than throw, but asBigDecimal uses NumberLimits.parseBigDecimal, which can throw NumberFormatException for strings over 10,000 chars or with absolute scale >= 10,000.

grp:LazilyParsedNumber.java-lazilyparsednumber-value-semantics-and-serialization: says writeReplace substitutes a BigDecimal, but it calls asBigDecimal/NumberLimits.parseBigDecimal and can throw NumberFormatException for invalid or over-limit strings.

grp:TypeToken.java-typetoken-assignability-internals: says the parameterized check builds a type-variable map from the source's actual arguments, but it only does so when the source is a ParameterizedType; otherwise it skips typeEquals and recurses into interfaces/superclass.

grp:TypeToken.java-typetoken-factories: says getParameterized throws IllegalArgumentException if rawType is not a Class, but a null rawType is rejected earlier by Objects.requireNonNull and throws NullPointerException.
